```{python}
#| label: fig-going-report-stats-meeting-level-2024
#| fig-cap: ""
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 6.2

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

summary = pd.read_csv("../data/config/jcr_going_report_stats_meeting_level_2024_summary.csv")
statuses = ["Green", "Orange", "Blue", "Red"]
colors = {"Green": "#008000", "Orange": "#ED7D31", "Blue": "#4472C4", "Red": "#C00000"}
totals = summary[statuses].sum(axis=1)
percentages = summary[statuses].div(totals.replace(0, 1), axis=0).mul(100)
bottom = pd.Series(0.0, index=summary.index)
x = range(len(summary))
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 6.2), dpi=160)
for status in statuses:
    values = percentages[status]
    bars = ax.bar(x, values, bottom=bottom, color=colors[status], label=status, width=0.78)
    for bar, value in zip(bars, values):
        if value > 0 and bar.get_height() >= 1.5:
            ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height() / 2,
                    f"{value:.0f}%", ha="center", va="center", color="white",
                    fontsize=9, fontweight="bold")
    bottom += values
ax.set_xticks(list(x), summary["course_name"], rotation=45, ha="right")
ax.set_ylabel("Share of meetings (%)")
ax.set_ylim(0, 100)
ax.set_yticks(range(0, 101, 20))
ax.set_xlabel("")
ax.grid(axis="y", color="#D9E2F3")
ax.set_axisbelow(True)
ax.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)
ax.legend(ncol=4, loc="upper center", bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.18), frameon=False)
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
